# Paper Source

Paper Source is a light mint typewriter aesthetic that sets notes in Source Code Pro with justified text and organic green and orange accents. Bold and italic text is highlighted in warm orange, backlinks are underlined in tan and headings are color-coded in green. Its dark mode uses dark-green surfaces with mint text.

![Paper Source screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brightwav3/obsidian-paper-source-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Paper Source"
    author: "Brightwav3"
    repo:   "brightwav3/obsidian-paper-source-theme"
    slug:   "paper-source"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/paper-source"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/brightwav3/obsidian-paper-source-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brightwav3/obsidian-paper-source-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a light mint typewriter aesthetic with Source Code Pro across notes, justified text, and organic green/orange accents. Highlight bold and italic text in warm orange, underline backlinks in tan, color-code headings in green, and switch to a premium dark mode with dark-green surfaces and mint text."
}
```
